decisions.decision: Roadmap D4 corrected from four truncators to three; supercharger.go:57 is startOfMonth, not a second startOfDay.
decisions.why: Tier-1 worker read the source and was right; leader verified with a func-definition grep. startOfDay is defined once (history.go:61), so tier 6 changes one definition, not two.

decisions.decision: Worker deferred internal/clock/AGENTS.md and the four doc edits to tasks.md (T3-T7) instead of writing them in this artifacts-only run.

decisions.decision: Drop the time/tzdata blank import. internal/clock imports stdlib time and nothing else, no exception.
decisions.why: Project ships no containers — deployment is a runbook onto hosts that all carry system tzdata. D2's constraint is worth more absolute than with one standing exception.

decisions.decision: Zone() panics at init if America/Bogota fails to load, rather than falling back to UTC.
decisions.why: Owner accepted the crash-on-boot consequence. A silent UTC fallback would defeat the roadmap without anyone noticing until day attribution had drifted.

decisions.decision: Three waves, one serial worker each: W1=T1,T2,T6; W2=T3,T4,T5,T7; W3=T8 run by the leader.
decisions.why: Tasks are small; one dispatch amortizes the doc-pack read across them. Parallel workers would re-read the pack and drain the same bucket faster. T8 is build/vet/gofmt/grep — leader-allowed signals.
